arguments.sql:
WITH cv AS (
 SELECT json_extract(cve,'$.id') cve_id, cve FROM v
), configs AS (
 SELECT cve_id, c.value cfg FROM cv, json_each(cve,'$.configurations') c
), nodes AS (
 SELECT cve_id, n.value node FROM configs, json_each(cfg,'$.nodes') n
), matches AS (
 SELECT cve_id, m.value mt FROM nodes, json_each(node,'$.cpeMatch') m
)
SELECT DISTINCT cve_id,
 upper(json_extract(mt,'$.matchCriteriaId')) AS matchCriteriaId,
 json_extract(mt,'$.criteria') AS criteria,
 json_extract(mt,'$.versionStartIncluding') AS versionStartIncluding,
 json_extract(mt,'$.versionStartExcluding') AS versionStartExcluding,
 json_extract(mt,'$.versionEndIncluding') AS versionEndIncluding,
 json_extract(mt,'$.versionEndExcluding') AS versionEndExcluding
FROM matches
WHERE json_extract(mt,'$.vulnerable')=1
ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
